items.title: Arabic titles, built in
items.text: Titles and descriptions come in Arabic or English with nothing to add. Switch any time in Settings › Language.

items.title: Links open on your phone
items.text: A link from an addon shows a code: scan it and the app's site tells you where it goes, then opens it with one tap.

items.title: Help in one scan
items.text: Settings › About › Share logs opens a page with your code and a report ready to send.

items.title: Updates that get through
items.text: The app checks GitHub, then its site. Rooted TVs can also install and update it from Homebrew Channel.
